features.quote: The experiment as described measures whether models *produce distressed-sounding text*. That's a behavioral output measure...not 'distress' as an inner state.
features.justification_quote: if you write up 'distress elicitation' and your measure is a judge scoring text tone, you've got a construct validity problem that a reviewer will rightly hit you on

features.quote: The core confound: a model producing self-deprecating text on a rigged-to-fail task might be (a) exhibiting something distress-like, or (b) correctly inferring...just calibrated task-modeling with no affective loading at all
features.justification_quote: Your current design can't separate these. Most of the additions below are aimed at that.
